native_rules.description: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

If your Army Faction is Asuryani, at the start of each battle round you receive Battle Focus tokens: Incursion 2, Strike Force 4, Onslaught 6. Spend tokens to enable eligible Agile Manoeuvres; unused tokens expire at the end of the battle round. Consult the full faction rule for manoeuvre triggers and effects.

Models in that unit do not need to take Desperate Escape tests due to Falling Back while Battle-shocked, except for those that will move over enemy models when doing so.
